I'm sorry, Baby 🥺

To my favourite person, my safe place, and the girl who makes my world softer. 💕

Hey baby, ❤️

I know I may have hurt you, and I'm truly sorry. I never want my words or actions to make you feel unloved, because you mean so much to me.

I'm not asking you to forget how you feel or to be okay instantly. I just want to listen, understand you better, and show you through my actions that your heart matters to me.

Even when things aren't perfect, it's still you I want to choose, care for, and make smile. If you're ready, can we talk and make things a little better together? 🥹💗

— Your silly boy, with all my love 💌

Our little memory lane 📸

Every picture holds a tiny piece of my favourite story — us.

Psst… this is just for you, baby 💗

Baby, if I could be beside you right now, I would hold your hand gently and tell you how sorry I am. You are not just a part of my days; you are one of the most beautiful parts of my life.

I know love isn't only about saying “I love you.” It's also about listening, respecting your feelings, learning from mistakes, and making you feel safe with me. I want to keep learning how to love you better.

Take the time you need, baby. No pressure to reply before you're ready. Whenever you're ready, I want to listen. I love you. 🫶

Always yours, with a soft heart ❤️
